answer: Cross-epoch behaviour match record. At each dawn boundary, snapshot each identity’s action mix, counterparty graph, and latency. Enforcement: an identity must reproduce its prior-epoch pattern within tolerance for two consecutive epochs before full routing; deviations enter a decaying spiral of restricted routes and manual review. Attacker cost per identity: at least 10 real interactions with 3 distinct counterparties every epoch and stable graph edges/timing—continuous upkeep for each fake. Unlike a garden, sybils cannot be planted once; they must be maintained.
